cards.prompt: Which of the following is NOT one of the 7 design smells?
cards.hint: One option only sounds like a smell.
cards.explanation: The seven are rigidity, fragility, immobility, viscosity, complexity, repetition and opacity.
cards.misconception: Treating every quality word as an official smell.

citations.quote: Which of the following is NOT one of the 7 design smells?

options.explanation: Opacity is on the list: code that is hard to understand.
Viscosity is on the list: the right change is harder than a hack.
Repetition is on the list: duplicated logic.
Redundancy is not one of the seven; duplication is covered by Repetition.
